period_note: Extracted from Trust Bank's own annual-report-embedded 'Audit Committee and the Board Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table (a BSEC corporate-governance-mandated disclosure). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 of the same year (the source table's own column header reads '01 Jan to <quarter-end date>'), not discrete-quarter figures, flagged via the _cumulative suffix; balance-sheet items are the period-end snapshot. BASIS MISMATCH FLAGGED: this table's own text states the Board approved the CONSOLIDATED financial statements for quarterly disclosure every year it appears (2018, 2020-2025) — this differs from Trust Bank's main Q4/annual series in this dataset, which is SOLO (Bank-only, unconsolidated) basis for balance-sheet/income-statement items (see sources.json top-level reporting_basis, confirmed 2026-08-26). Verified numerically for FY2017: this table's own Q4/full-year column reports Total Assets 241,319 (Consolidated) vs this dataset's SOLO-basis FY2017 Q4 Total Assets 239,770.63 — a 0.65% gap, consistent with Trust Bank's small subsidiaries (Trust Bank Investment Ltd, Trust Bank Securities Ltd, Trust Axiata Digital Ltd) being added net of intercompany eliminations on consolidation, not a data error. Do not directly mix these CONSOLIDATED Q1-Q3 figures with this bank's SOLO-basis Q4/annual figures without adjusting for this basis gap. Source document is a LATER annual report's comparative-year column for FY2017 (FY2017's own annual report does not contain usable data for this). No second report available to cross-check against: FY2017's own annual report lacks this table entirely (the BSEC disclosure was not yet part of Trust Bank's report format before FY2018), and no FY2016 comparative exists in a later report. This quarter's figures rest on the FY2018 report's comparative column alone.
